tasks.title: Report totals by month
tasks.description: A new src/dates.mjs exports monthKey(at): the "YYYY-MM" of a Date or ISO string, in UTC. report.byMonth(entries) returns an object mapping each month key to the sum of its cents, with keys in ascending order; no entries gives {}.
scenarios: Given entries on 2026-01-05 (100) and 2026-01-20 (50) and 2026-03-01 (7) When byMonth is called Then it returns { "2026-01": 150, "2026-03": 7 }
Given an entry at "2026-01-31T23:30:00-02:00" When monthKey is called Then it returns "2026-02" (UTC)
Given entries out of order When byMonth is called Then Object.keys of the result are ascending
Given [] When byMonth is called Then it returns {}
Given a Date object When monthKey is called Then it gives the same key as its ISO string
